Settings and controls

Use the selected keys or arrows to drive. Hold Shift for nitro or V to look back. Hold Down Arrow to brake, then keep holding it to reverse. Hold Up Arrow to brake while backing up and drive forward again. B still selects direction manually at a stop. Space fires an EMP. Q/E shift, M switches transmission, C changes camera, F3 shows telemetry and Esc pauses. H repairs the body and tires and puts a rolled car back on its wheels. R resets in free drive. With touch controls, hold a direction and Gas or Brake together.

Standard controller · RT/LT throttle and brake · D-pad up repairs · D-pad down switches reverse/forward at a stop · left stick steer · A nitro · B EMP · hold left stick click to look back · LB/RB shift · Y reset · right stick click camera · X telemetry · Menu pause.
